data.name: Wrath of Mynah
data.detailed_description:
Wrath of Mynah is a turn-based RPG adventure game that follows the gripping story of The Great Hanyem War. Hundreds of years after Mynah Smith arrived on Hanyem, you play as Pike Gilder, a petty thief who wants to make a difference in the everlasting fight against the tyrannical Indigallo Federation as they lose their grip over their territories. Join forces with a plethora of unique party members, such as Tusk, Liz Fureon, Deven Proditor, Rosie, Nova Acri, and Val Fortis! Collect items, armor and weapons! Uncover the deep history  and lore of Hanyem and the human, felibrawno, and gisharen people. Eventually you will be prepared for the ultimate battle against the mysterious General Zed Aurum and King Mynah Smith IX!

Controls:

  • Arrow keys for movement

  • Space or enter for selection

  • Shift to dash and go back in menus

  • X to open or close a menu

  • Mouse also works for like everything if you feel like it

Have fun, I hope you all enjoy exploring this world I've made.

Made by BluWind
Portraits by Sharkekei
Cutscenes by MrWalrusTheGiraffe, Janaeither, and Javier 89 Javier
Plugins by CardCaph, SRDude, and Mjshi
Music by MrWalrusTheGiraffe, Axi, and Kacper Cieśluk
Additional art by OMI and Sharkekei
King Mynah Smith IX voiced by Albie Robles
General Zed Aurum voiced by Oliver Hetherington
Special thanks to AngelJar, Valkienyx, PermanX, Luckynumchris, JMcKennaStories, and Maya KL
